content: For point-in-polygon against ~9,410 ward polygons and tens of thousands of points, shapely 2.x's vectorized shapely.contains() ufunc and built-in GEOS-backed STRtree spatial index are sufficient and lighter than geopandas; geopandas sjoin wraps the same shapely/GEOS machinery but pulls in pyproj/pyogrio/GDAL, adding cold-start weight not needed for a row-aligned exact ward-polygon lookup.
